raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated two different historical figures named “Anna of Hungary,” assuming Andronikos II’s wife (the Byzantine empress, daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman) had Maria Laskarina as her mother. This mixes her up with Anna of Hungary, Duchess of Macsó (daughter of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina). That incorrect assumption (“i.e., Maria Laskarina”) set the analysis on the wrong lineage despite later search results showing the empress’s mother was Elizabeth the Cuman.
